name: Tiger 2
subtitle: UCLA cut
goal: Get the point guard a layup by cutting off the high-post screen.
options: Best: 1 on the UCLA cut. Next: 5 off the pick. Safety: 3 at the top to reverse it.

steps.note: 1 cuts hard off 4's shoulder to the block. That is the UCLA cut. 2 looks for the layup pass.
4 goes to pick away for 5. 3 fills the top. 1 clears out to the far wing.
5 comes off the pick to the ball-side elbow. 4 comes back and dives to the block.
